title: Walmart Shoplifter Goes Completely Nuts When Caught
description:
On a bright sunny day, Florida officers were on the lookout for a suspect in a theft case from earlier in the morning. Although successful in evading them once, the male was later spotted by the officers next to a highway with his dog on a leash. In a surprising turn of events, the dog bit the male on his thigh but remained very calm with the officers. The male claimed that he knew things that the government didn’t want anyone to know but did he know better than to keep resisting? Let’s find out. The male was charged with resisting arrest with violence while his dog was taken in possession by the Animal Control.
